summary: This directory contains the testing suite for verifying the logic and integrity of package build concepts. It serves as a validation layer for ensuring that the mechanisms used to define and construct packages function correctly according to the defined specifications.
responsibilities: Test package definition and construction processes
relationships: The test suite validates the logic defined in the package construction process.
Package build concepts are evaluated by the testing suite to ensure adherence to requirements.
designDecisions: Colocation of test files with build-related modules
